messages:
mira: Heads up, merged PR #1102 changed the dashboard schema key `latency_buckets` -> `latency_percentiles`. Console preview now errors for our Dashboard examples (400 schema validation). Noticed while validating the migration guide.

devon: yikes. which docs are affected? quick grep?

mira: Affected pages: docs/console/observability/dashboards.md, examples/dashboard/slo_latency.json, quickstarts/latency-breakdown.md. The examples embed the old key exactly so generation fails.

sanjay: i can push a docs hotfix to replace the key in the examples, but we should consider a short-term compatibility layer in the dashboard parser so production dashboards keep rendering. ops will need to weigh in.

rachel: Agree with sanjay. If we only patch docs, customers with existing saved dashboards may still break when the backend enforces the new key. Do we know if the server accepts both?

mira: Server currently rejects unknown keys. Backend change was intentional to adopt percentile-style config, but we need to avoid breaking saved dashboards.

devon: Quick plan: (1) docs hotfix patch replacing examples and adding migration note; (2) backend accepts both keys for 4 weeks and emits a warning in the UI; (3) add a deprecation note and calendar reminder to remove alias. Who volunteers?

sanjay: i'll take backend alias + warning UI. i'll open an RFC PR for removal after 4 weeks.

rachel: i'll do docs edits and add a clear "Migration" block with copy/paste JSON. Also add a small script snippet for converting old dashboards to new form. Example below: 

```
# converter (bash + jq)
jq '.panels |= map(.config |= (if has("latency_buckets") then . + {"latency_percentiles": .latency_buckets} | del(.latency_buckets) else . end))' old_dashboard.json > new_dashboard.json
```

rachel: i'll link to examples in three languages and update the quickstart screenshots.

mira: CI: the docs generation job is failing on examples/dashboard/slo_latency.json validation. Can we land docs PR behind a canary?

ci-bot: docs CI failure: examples/dashboard/slo_latency.json schema validation error (unknown property: latency_buckets). See https://ci.redwood/inference/1102/build/3

devon: let's do this: rachel opens docs PR with edits + migration guide; sanjay will open backend compat PR; once both pass CI we merge docs first, regenerate any embedded snippets, then merge backend compat and monitor canary for 2 hours before wider rollout.

rachel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1164 — replaces key in examples, adds "Migration from latency_buckets" section, includes the jq snippet above, and updates screenshots. Requesting mira for docs review.

sanjay: backend PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/554 — alias acceptance + UI warning in canary. Note: UI warning shown only if both keys present, message: "`latency_buckets` is deprecated, use `latency_percentiles` (values are percentiles: 50, 90, 99)."

mira: thank you both. timeline: merge docs PR after a green build, then trigger snippet regen. sanjay, after your PR merges, please post the canary link to the playground so product can smoke-test examples.

devon: i'll handle the snippet regen job and watch for embed breakage. also add a short FAQ entry: "Why did my dashboard panels disappear?" with steps to convert.

rachel: assigned: rachel -> docs PR and screenshots, devon -> snippet regen + QA, sanjay -> backend alias + UI warning, mira -> final docs sign-off and release comms.

mira: leaving a follow-up: add an automated lint rule in docs CI to detect deprecated keys in examples so this kind of mismatch is caught before merges. Filed issue #231 for that. :eyes:
